data.description: A terminal surface created over the socket with new-surface into a pane where another tab is selected never starts its PTY until a human focuses it, so an automation that creates a hosting tab and waits for a shell hangs. launch-agent-created surfaces do not have this problem. Expected: a socket-created terminal surface starts its PTY at creation regardless of focus. Found by the Overwatch seat launcher (hands-on surface, 2026-09-25).
data.title: c11: a socket-created tab (new-surface) gets no PTY until it is focused; start the PTY at creation

data.body: The 1.0 fix for a socket-created tab that gets no PTY until focus is C11-295 (cold start, ledger B003) and C11-296 (a screen read starts a cold terminal, ledger B087). C11-295 depends on the Ghostty mailbox patch set C11-294. This ticket stays the incident record. Do not open another PTY-start fix.

data.reason: Absorbed by c11 1.0 or earlier runs; verification tracked once in C11-319 (2026-10-02 backlog review, Atin approved)
